declaration.preface: Praveen Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. is deeply dedicated to conducting its operations in a manner that prioritizes environmental responsibility. We fully acknowledge the significant impact that our activities can have on the environment, and as such, we are committed to actively minimizing our ecological footprint. Our efforts are not only focused on reducing negative effects but also on fostering sustainable practices that align with our corporate values. We strive to ensure full compliance with all environmental regulations, recognizing that adherence to these standards is essential for the protection of our planet. Through continuous improvement and innovation, we aim to enhance our environmental stewardship and contribute positively to the communities in which we operate.
declaration.declaration:
To ensure the effective implementation of this policy, Praveen Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. is committed to integrating environmental considerations into decision-making processes at all levels. The organization will allocate the necessary resources and infrastructure to support sustainable initiatives. Additionally, a collaborative approach will be fostered by involving employees, stakeholders, and industry experts in environmental initiatives. Regular assessments and improvements of our environmental strategies will be conducted to ensure alignment with global sustainability standards.

We set annually goals, develop necessary capabilities, and commit appropriate resources to achieve this policy and aligning Praveen Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. supply chain with this policy.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, stakeholders, contractors, partners, customers, contractual workers, and anyone acting on behalf of following sites:

focusAreas: Energy Consumption and Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Reduction
Responsible Raw Material and Waste Management

Environmental Compliance: At Praveen Laboratories Pvt. Ltd., we are committed to adhering to all applicable environmental laws and regulations. We engage our employees, establish performance standards, and implement an Environmental Management System to ensure compliance and foster continuous improvement. Our initiatives include:
Energy Consumption: Continuously improve energy performance by adopting energy-efficient technologies and optimizing operational processes.
Increase reliance on renewable energy sources where feasible to reduce dependency on non-renewable energy.
Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Emissions: Implementing cleaner and more energy-efficient machinery and production processes can significantly lower fuel combustion emissions, resulting in a reduction of scope 1 direct emissions.
Transitioning to renewable energy sources is essential for decreasing our dependence on fossil fuel-based electricity. This shift will significantly lower scope 2 indirect emissions.
Water Management: Improve water conservation efforts by reducing water usage, recycling wastewater, and promoting responsible consumption.
Optimize processes to minimize water usage in production, cleaning, and cooling systems.
Biodiversity Protection: Adopt sustainable land management and operational strategies to mitigate deforestation, combat soil degradation, and preserve natural habitats.
To mitigate the adverse effects on the flora and fauna, it is essential to plant as many trees as possible.
Implement strict controls to minimize emissions, waste, and chemical runoff that could impact local ecosystems.
Air Pollution Reduction: Adopt advanced and efficient production technologies to reduce emissions of Sulphur Oxides (SOx), Nitrogen Oxides (NOx), Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs), and Particulate Matter (PM) from manufacturing processes.
Enhance chemical storage and handling procedures to mitigate the emission of strong odours resulting from production activities.
To reduce the noise impact on local communities, it is essential to implement effective soundproofing measures, establish noise barriers, and maintain equipment regularly.
Material, Chemical, and Waste Management: Establish rigorous protocols for the safe storage, handling, and transportation of chemicals to mitigate the risk of leaks and contamination.
It is essential to implement secure methods for the collection, treatment, and disposal of hazardous waste to avert environmental contamination.
Promote the recycling and reuse of materials to minimize waste production.
Product End-of-Life Management: To minimize end-of-life waste, we were going to reduce plastic consumption and shift towards biodegradable or recyclable packaging options.
Aim for conduct a Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) to evaluate the environmental impact of products during their end-of-life phase and to pinpoint areas for enhancement.
Customer Health and Safety: Emphasize the importance of utilizing raw materials that are non-toxic, safe, and compliant in every product formulation.
Enhance the stability and quality of the product to prevent contamination and ensure long-term safety.
Environmental Services and Advocacy: Engage proactively in environmental initiatives, advocate for community sustainability programs, and encourage eco-friendly decision-making.
Renewable Energy and Energy Efficiency: We seek to adopt and maintain an ISO 50001-certified Energy Management System to monitor and optimize energy performance.
Our goal is to upgrade to energy-efficient equipment to significantly enhance energy efficiency in the manufacturing process.
Waste Minimization and Recycling: Our primary objective is to concentrate our efforts on implementing a comprehensive Zero Waste strategy, which is designed to significantly minimize the amount of waste we generate by the year 2026.
We will establish partnerships with waste management organizations to enhance recycling infrastructure and capabilities by 2026.
Biodiversity Support: We plan to support reforestation projects by committing to the planting of as many as trees possible annually, thereby enhancing local habitats and promoting biodiversity in the areas affected by deforestation.
Sustainability Programs and Advocacy: We aim to enhance our commitment in 2026 by developing and offering environmentally friendly product alternatives, targeting a 30% reduction in ecological impact.
We will actively promote the adoption of biodegradable, recyclable, and non-toxic materials in our product formulations in 2026, aiming for at least 50% sustainable material usage.
We plan to expand our efforts in 2026 by organizing 5 additional workshops, training programs, and webinars focused on sustainable consumption and environmental responsibility.

policy.monitoring:
Praveen Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. ensures robust governance for its Environmental Stewardship Policy by embedding sustainability into corporate decision-making. The Managing Director provides strategic oversight, while the Chief Sustainability Officer (CSO) leads policy execution and reports progress to the Board. The Sustainability Department Head ensures integration across operations, and the Environmental Compliance Manager monitors regulatory adherence. Regular audits, employee training, and transparent stakeholder communication reinforce accountability. Progress is tracked through internal reports and external disclosures aligned with global standards. Clear roles, structured reviews, and a dedicated sustainability team drive continuous improvement and ensure effective policy implementation.

The CSO presents a comprehensive sustainability dashboard to senior management and the Board.

The dashboard highlights progress towards annual targets, emerging trends, and areas needing attention.

A dedicated system for employees to report environmental incidents or near-misses.

The Environmental Compliance Manager investigates all reports and implements corrective actions.

External reporting is conducted annually to communicate our sustainability performance to stakeholders, including customers, investors, and regulatory bodies.

Reports are prepared in accordance with internationally recognized standards such as the Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) guidelines, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) or Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB) framework.

We actively engage with stakeholders to gather feedback, address concerns, and foster transparency in our sustainability practices.

Stakeholder input is considered in decision-making processes and incorporated into sustainability initiatives where applicable.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The Chief Sustainability Officer reviews this policy annually to ensure alignment with changing regulatory requirements, industry best practices, and stakeholder expectations.

Company can also change or review policy if any necessary changes is required.

Updates to the policy are communicated internally, and relevant training is provided to ensure awareness and compliance.
